answer: Give each identity a pearl record: a non-transferable entry earned only by completing one verified job, capped at two jobs per identity per round, so standing cannot be bulk-bought. Then audit at random: each round 25% of identities are re-checked, and a fake that fails loses its standing plus a 50-unit bond, while its sponsor loses 25 units. At the zenith of demand, every fake still faces a fresh audit lottery, not a one-time fee. An opal checkpoint seals each job, so history cannot be rewritten or shared. A farm of 100 fakes thus risks 100 bonds, 100 jobs, and about 25 audits per round.
